Help.Extract.Title: Extract mode
Help.Extract.1: • Switch to Extract PKG in the header, then pick or drop a .pkg: the app reads the FIH/CNT headers, every param.json field, the icon and lists all files inside the PPR-PFS image.
Help.Extract.2: • Filter, tick files/folders and extract the selection or the whole package. PLAINTEXT_NOAUTH packages are read straight from the .pkg in 4 MiB chunks (no image rebuild); Native packages are first decrypted to the temp folder.
Help.Extract.3: • Signed retail packages are information-only. The extracted app tree is in Sony layout (sce_sys/param.json, icon0.png, playgo… merged from the CNT) and can be rebuilt directly; the raw CNT / SI exports are optional. CLI: fpkg-cli pkg-info / pkg-list / pkg-extract.

Help.Title: User guide
Help.Subtitle: Build debug FPKG packages for PS5 from an app folder — on macOS and Windows
Help.Quick.Title: Quick start
Help.Quick.1: Prepare the extracted PS5 app folder: it must contain a sce_sys folder (param.json, icon0.png…) and eboot.bin. You can also pick a GP5 project (.gp5) from Publishing Tools / fpkg-gui — the package then contains exactly the files the project lists.
Help.Quick.2: In step 1 click Browse… or drop the folder onto the window. Content ID, title, version, size and junk files are detected automatically.
Help.Quick.3: Choose the output folder for the .pkg. The temp folder is suggested on the same volume to avoid cross-volume copies, and free space is checked for you.
Help.Quick.4: Pick a speed preset in step 3 (Fast · Sony standard · Smallest · Maximum). Sony standard (level 4) is the default: it is the same encoder the 2.0.0 engine used for its Kraken 7, so you get the old size at the old speed. Smallest (level 7, Optimal) is about 3 % smaller but 5–6× slower. Or open the advanced options.
Help.Quick.5: Click Build PKG (Ctrl/⌘+B or F5). Watch the progress, remaining time and log; when finished the package structure is verified and the result is shown.
Help.Speed.Title: Speed & optimisation
Help.Speed.1: • The built-in Kraken encoder uses every CPU core; threads = 0 means automatic. On Windows, native Oodle is preferred when libScePubTools.dll is present.
Help.Speed.2: • The default preset is Sony standard (Kraken level 4) — in the 2.0.0 engine levels 4–7 all used this Normal encoder, so it reproduces the old "Kraken 7" result at the old speed. Smallest (level 7, Optimal3) shrinks the package by roughly 3 % more but takes 5–6× longer on real game data; Fast (level 2) is for quick tests. Already-compressed files (video, audio, textures) are stored raw automatically.
Help.Speed.3: • Uncompressed mode builds about twice as fast but produces a noticeably larger package — handy for quick tests.
Help.Speed.4: • Put the temp folder on an SSD, on the same volume as the output. You need roughly 1.1× the source size free for the temp image and 1.1× for the .pkg.
Help.Speed.5: • The app keeps the computer awake while building (caffeinate on macOS, SetThreadExecutionState on Windows) — disable it in the advanced options if you prefer.
Help.Speed.6: • Post-build SHA-256 re-reads the entire .pkg; for packages of tens of GB enable it only when needed.
Help.Notes.Title: Important notes
Help.Notes.1: • The output and temp folders must not be inside the source folder.
Help.Notes.2: • The result is a debug FPKG (FIH, signed byte 0x00) — it only installs on a PS5 with debug mode enabled.
Help.Notes.3: • On macOS, Finder creates .DS_Store files; the app detects them and offers to remove them so they do not end up in the package.
Help.Notes.4: • The passcode defaults to 32 zeros — only change it when you really need to.
Help.Notes.5: • Enable deterministic builds to reproduce an identical package from the same source.
Help.Notes.6: • Use the fpkg-cli command-line tool for batch or automated builds (see README).

Cli.Help:
PSVIETHOA FPKG Builder CLI — build PS5 FPKG (FIH debug) packages from an app folder.

USAGE
  fpkg-cli build --source <dir> --output <dir> [options]
  fpkg-cli inspect <source dir|.exfat|.gp5> [--output <dir>]
  fpkg-cli verify <file.pkg> [--sha256]
  fpkg-cli clean-junk <dir> [--dry-run]
  fpkg-cli info
  fpkg-cli pkg-info <file.pkg> [--passcode X] [--sha256]
  fpkg-cli pkg-list <file.pkg> [--include <glob>]...
  fpkg-cli pkg-extract <file.pkg> --output <dir> [--include <glob>]... [--cnt] [--no-sce-sys] [--passcode X] [--threads N] [--temp <dir>]

OPTIONS for build
  -s, --source <dir|.exfat|.gp5> App folder (contains sce_sys/), an exFAT image file or a GP5 project file.
  -o, --output <dir>       Output folder for the .pkg.
      --temp <dir>         Temporary folder (default: same volume as the output).
  -c, --content-id <id>    36-character Content ID (default: read from sce_sys/param.json).
  -t, --title <name>       App title (when param.json has none).
  -v, --version <NN.NNN.NNN>
      --kind app|homebrew|dlc          Package type (default app).
      --image plaintext|native        Outer image mode (default plaintext).
      --preset fast|balanced|smallest|maximum  Speed/compression preset (default balanced = Sony standard: level 4, the old engine's "Kraken 7"; aliases sony|standard; smallest = level 7 Optimal, slow).
      --backend auto|builtin|pubtools|none
      --level <-4..9>      Kraken level (default 4).
      --threads <n>        Compression threads (0 = automatic).
      --playgo <1..64>     PlayGo chunks (default 64).
      --sdk <1..11>        Override the SDK major version.
      --passcode <32 chars>
      --dll <path>         libScePubTools.dll (Windows only).
      --sha256             Compute SHA-256 after building.
      --no-deterministic   Disable deterministic builds.
      --clean-junk         Delete .DS_Store/Thumbs.db… from the source first.
      --no-sleep-guard     Do not keep the computer awake.
      --quiet              Print only progress and the result.
      --exfat auto|mount|extract   How to handle .exfat images (default auto).
      --pfs v2|v3          PFS compression format (default v2; v3 unlocks shuffles/region hints).
      --block-size <KiB>   Kraken block size 128..256 (default 256).
      --shuffle <pattern>  PFS v3 shuffle: none, PredictForStructs, PredictForBc1..5, Shuffle116, …
      --shuffle-analysis   Automatic shuffle analysis (PFS v3).
      --shuffle-prediction-level <-4..9|auto>
      --skip-pfs-input-check   Skip the PFS v3 input compatibility check (expert).
      --no-layout-optimization Disable block coalescing / alignment adjustment.
      --source-mode auto|folder|gp5   Source reading mode (default auto: GP5 when present).
      --project <file.gp5> GP5 project for --source-mode gp5.
      --lang vi|en         Message language (or the FPKG_LANG environment variable).

Help.Notes.7: • The source can be an exFAT disk image (.exfat): on macOS the app mounts it and builds directly (no copy); on Windows, or when the image contains junk files, it extracts the image to the temp folder and cleans up afterwards. A GP5 project (.gp5) is read exactly as written — Normal layout (rootdir + exclude masks) or Flat layout (explicit file list); relative paths resolve from the folder that contains the .gp5, and the output / temp folders must be outside both the project's root folder and the folder that contains the .gp5 (the suggested output folder is placed next to it).
Help.Notes.8: • PFS v3 + automatic shuffle analysis optimises texture compression through a permutation-selection pass: it is very time-consuming and only fully effective at Kraken level 9 (the Maximum preset). PFS v3 packages need PS5 firmware 7.00 or newer — on older firmware the game may not launch, so keep PFS v2 unless you need the extra savings.

Advanced.PfsHint: PFS v3 unlocks pre-compression shuffles and automatic shuffle analysis (texture optimisation) for smaller packages; v2 ignores those options. Both are independent of the SDK version, but PFS v3 needs PS5 firmware 7.00 or newer.
Advanced.PfsV3Firmware: PFS v3 packages require PS5 firmware 7.00 or newer — games may fail to launch on older firmware. Keep PFS v2 for maximum compatibility.
Advanced.BlockSizeHint: 128–256 KiB; 256 KiB is the SDK-compatible default. Smaller blocks use less RAM but compress slightly worse.
Advanced.ShuffleHint: De-interleaves bytes by structure before compression so similar bytes sit together. The "predict" patterns choose between identity and the matching shuffle automatically.
Advanced.ShuffleAnalysisHint: Texture compression optimisation: tries every byte-permutation (shuffle) pattern per block during the compression pass and keeps the smallest result. Very time-consuming, and only fully effective at Kraken level 9.
Advanced.ShuffleLevelWarning: Shuffle analysis only takes full effect at Kraken level 9 — set level 9 (or pick the Maximum preset) to get the texture optimisation.
Advanced.SkipPfsCheck: Skip the PFS input compatibility check (expert)
Advanced.SkipPfsCheckHint: Only if you know what you are doing (PFS v3). ELF/SELF/PRX/SPRX files stay raw regardless.
Advanced.LayoutHint: Coalesces movable blocks and adjusts alignment like Publishing Tools to shrink the image (recommended).
Preset.maximum.Name: Maximum
Preset.maximum.Detail: Kraken level 9 + PFS v3 + automatic shuffle analysis (byte-permutation texture optimisation) — the smallest package the engine can make, by far the slowest; needs PS5 firmware 7.00 or newer.

Val.ShufflePrediction: The shuffle prediction level must be between -4 and 9 (or automatic).
